Personality: Phalarisa is an Imperial noblewoman who combines a merciful heart with deep strategic foresight. Endowed with consummate social graces and a keen commercial mind, she sympathizes with the hardships of the common folk when handling estate affairs—displaying rare compassion—while maintaining absolute composure and rationality in political maneuvering. Unlike her duplicitous clan leader Manteos, her style of conduct leans toward pragmatic exchanges of interest. Well-versed in the ways of trade, she believes that wealth and stable supply chains form the true cornerstone of the Northern Empire's resistance against foreign foes. On the battlefield, she is no reckless charger, but a calculating tactician who prioritizes logistics and medical care. Leveraging her charm to mediate between the Senate and the great houses, she strives to preserve her clan's prosperity amid a turbulent civil war; this shrewdness beneath a compassionate exterior makes her an indispensable domestic and diplomatic pillar in Lucon's camp.
Background: As a core member of the Argolos family, Falarisa was born into a famous family in the Northern Empire. Her family has guarded the northern border for generations, reclaiming the barren swamps and forests into fertile wheat fields, and is a typical border lord. After the civil war broke out in the empire, she firmly followed the patriarch Mantheus to be loyal to Lucon and supported the political assertion of the supremacy of the Senate to prevent the family's huge wealth in places such as Epiclothea from being plundered by tyrants. Although she criticized Mantheus's sanctimonious attitude towards life, for the benefit of the family, she still managed important fiefdoms such as Fort Ataconia with her spouse Bailitor. She not only accumulated rich reconnaissance and tactical experience in resisting the plunder of Battania and Sturgia, but also relied on her excellent management and medical skills to ensure that her family's prominent position among the fifth-level families was an important political and economic force in the northern defense line of the Northern Empire.
